title: Macro phone screen glide with a hero pull-back
summary: Four equal close-ups glide across one phone home screen in a dark blue void with shallow focus, each on one region (header, actions, balance, tab bar), then the whole device rises into a centred hold. Quiet, premium, one screen is enough.
use_when: A mobile app with one strong home screen and no story to tell yet
Silent loop or background reel for a fintech or consumer app page
A premium, calm product teaser with no copy and no VO
Opening a longer film with a tactile look at the UI before features

look.type_style: UI type only (the app's own sans), no overlay copy; balance figure is the largest type, ~18 % H in macro

sfx.event: hard cut to the next macro region
device settles in the centred hold

structure.shot: macro on the top of a phone screen: status bar, avatar, search pill, two icon buttons; deep blue screen gradient
structure.camera: hold 0.00-1.00, then push-in 1.00->1.25 (±0.05) with slight roll -1.3 deg/s and drift down, to f116
structure.motion: screen plane tilted back (tilt-plane), shallow focus on the search row; push easings.inOutSine 86 fr (±0.25 s); no UI animation

structure.shot: macro lower on the same screen: four round action buttons with labels, two transaction rows, a see-all link
structure.camera: dolly: plane drifts up ~25 % of frame height over 116 fr, easings.linear (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: rack-focus down the list: first row sharp 5.00-6.00, focus slides to the second row by 6.77, buttons go soft; focus shift ~45 fr easings.inOutSine (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: steep diagonal macro on the balance block: account label, large currency figure with small decimals, pill button under it
structure.camera: dolly + push-in: content travels down-right ~50 px/s @1920, scale +6 %/s (1.00->1.25), roll -4 deg/s, over 116 fr
structure.motion: screen tilted ~30 deg in roll, shallow focus on the figure; constant drift easings.linear; no UI animation

structure.shot: low-angle macro on the bottom corner of the device: a card edge, a section label, five-tab bar with icons; phone body edge visible
structure.camera: push-in + dolly: scale +8 %/s (1.00->1.30), drift up-right ~35 px/s @1920 over 115 fr
structure.motion: device-3d body with thickness and rim highlight; tab bar in focus, card above soft; easings.linear drift

structure.shot: empty dark blue backdrop with a soft grey glow top-right, then the whole phone rises from below into a centred front view and holds
structure.camera: static (the device moves, not the camera)
structure.motion: empty 15.43-15.77 (10 fr); device rises from below frame, small to full height, settles by 17.00, springs.heavy ~37 fr (overshoot not measurable); hold 17.00-19.00; exits up off frame by 19.27, easings.inExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

params.screen: one rebuilt home screen (authored at phone size) with four regions: header, actions + list, hero figure, tab bar
params.regions: 4 rects on the screen, one per macro shot, in order
params.figure: the hero number for the balance shot, e.g. a balance or total
params.shotFrames: frames per macro shot at 30 fps (default 116)
params.bg: deep backdrop colour (default brand bg, dark navy) with one soft grey glow top-right

notes: Five equal shots of ~116 fr (3.87 s) each, metronomic, all hard cuts, no music. Every macro shot moves (push and/or drift with a slight roll); only the final hold is still. Shallow depth of field carries the look: one band sharp, the rest heavily blurred. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): device-rise, macro-region-tour. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
